about.title: About People & Growth
about.subtitle: Marketing, Growth and AI strategy — and a voice on the social, economic and environmental issues shaping people and businesses
about.philosophySubtitle: Four levels of development that move together, from the individual to the business.
about.summaryBody1: People & Growth starts from the understanding that development doesn't happen in isolation. People, relationships, teams and businesses are connected — and understanding that relationship is essential to building real possibilities for development.
about.summaryBody2: From these four levels, we create content, talks, workshops and consulting for people entering the job market, for leaders, teams and organizations that want to understand and transform their contexts.
about.level1Desc: Self-knowledge, career, communication and decision-making, always considering the relationship between the individual and their context.
about.level2Desc: Leading means dealing with people, not just tasks: trust, conflict, power and organizational culture.
about.level3Desc: A team has its own dynamic — roles, goals and trust shape what the collective can build.
about.level4Desc: Strategy, data and reading scenarios to turn opportunities into real value.
